newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate down 60 bps to 11.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate down 60 bps to 11.1 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate fell 60 basis points to 11.1 percent on Monday in trade dominated by favourable term loans.
Fresh loans accounted for more than two thirds of the 44 million kuna total daily trade.
New call money loans, mostly struck at steady 10.5 percent, totalled 29.4 million kuna.
Insurers rolled over old money at a steady 9.0 percent, while short-term loans were rolled over at favourable 9.0 and 11 percent rates.
The central bank calculated its kuna midrates for Tuesday slightly weaker at 6.0454 against the dollar and firmer at 3.5723 against the German mark. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom 385-1-4557075
